summary: Static technical audit against expanded file (scripts/expand-md.js — no-op here, file carries no {{prompt:}} markers) + four compendiums (platform_and_boundaries, research_claims, prompts, pedagogy technical subset). File is a pure narrative closer lecture: zero fenced prompt blocks, zero [Skill: ] references, two body claims about Claude Code mechanics (subagents don't auto-load rules and are handed them at dispatch; ./CLAUDE.md and ./CLAUDE.local.md are session-inherited) that match verified platform facts (check_platform_and_boundaries.md §6d, §40-corollary) and are corroborated by the file's own maintainer note confirming CLAUDE.local.md auto-load was checked as 'platform-true' during the 2026-07-02 slides pass. Both maintainer-block citations (Klaassen/Every, two URLs) carry correct [practitioner direct, vendor venue] labels, correctly-formed freshness stamps per source-freshness-format.md, and were independently re-verified: both URLs live (HTTP 200, checked 2026-07-10), source-freshness.sh --target 2026-07-10 returns 0 block / 0 warn / 2 info (accepted CAVEATs) against this file. Body prose correctly keeps citation labels out of student-facing text (research_claims §1 scope carve-out) and cites in builder-voice prose, not a callout box (§10). The compound-engineering four-step naming in body ('plan, work, review, compound') is pinned to a verbatim quote in the second maintainer-block source, not a loose paraphrase (§1a satisfied). Both Quality-block SHAs (writing@3605eee, slides@47f3357) verified as real ancestor commits of current HEAD (66c9863). check_prompts.md's entire 47-rule surface is N/A across the board: the compendium's own scope trigger ('fire when writing ANY prompt block a student copies') never fires because the file contains no fenced copy-this content. No blocking findings. This instance supersedes a stale prior version of this file that flagged a REVISE for a missing Klaassen URL in the maintainer block — the current file state already carries both URLs in a 'Source verification — freshness stamps' section that postdates that prior audit.
